items.title: Add shared runtimeMode JSON contract with exact enums
items.context: Expose top-level runtimeMode in check --json and doctor --format=json through one shared core helper. Required fields: mode, source, requiresProjectJavaScriptRuntime, authority, message. mode enum: global-cli | project-local-package | packaged-runtime | compatibility-launcher | diagnostic-only. source enum: repo-local-dist | project-node-modules | packaged-runtime | external-development-engine | global-cli | unknown. Classification rules: project-local-package only when active CLI resolves through project root node_modules/project-local package; packaged-runtime when an explicit packaged runtime source/env is detected; global-cli when active CLI is global and no wrapper/dev engine is in play; compatibility-launcher when a thin launcher/fallback chain resolves repo-local dist, project node_modules fallback, external development engine, packaged runtime fallback, or global fallback; diagnostic-only when signals conflict or source is unknown. requiresProjectJavaScriptRuntime is true only for project-local-package. authority is always local-runtime-diagnostic-only in this story.

items.title: Render first-screen runtime footprint guidance
items.context: Plain check and doctor output must start with a concise runtime footprint summary. The first visible block must directly show current mode, whether project-local JS runtime/package.json/node_modules is required, and next safe/manual action. Example lines: `Runtime mode: compatibility-launcher`; `Project-local JavaScript runtime required: no`; `Next action: no managed asset drift` or `Next action: review unsafe managed assets manually`.
items.userSees: The first screen of plain `koala check` and plain `koala doctor` includes lines like `Runtime mode: compatibility-launcher`, `Project-local JavaScript runtime required: no`, and `Next action: no managed asset drift` or `Next action: review unsafe managed assets manually`.

items.title: Preserve and prove managed asset safe sync boundaries
items.context: Keep apply/upgrade limited to MISSING/STALE_SAFE and add focused smoke proof that unsafe statuses are refused with manual guidance. User-visible unsafe examples must include STALE_LOCAL_EDIT with `review local edits before overwriting`, CASE_MISMATCH with exact-casing/manual rename guidance, and INCOMPATIBLE with manual fix guidance. Apply/upgrade must not report unsafe items as repaired.
items.userSees: Unsafe drift is refused with visible manual guidance, for example `STALE_LOCAL_EDIT ... action: review local edits before overwriting`, `CASE_MISMATCH ... rename the path with exact casing`, or `INCOMPATIBLE ... fix manually`; apply/upgrade only reports repairs for MISSING/STALE_SAFE.

items.title: Build core and provide explicit Koala Mac consumer proof handoff
items.context: Run the Orchestrate packages/main build and focused core smoke tests. Then write the concrete external handoff surface for Koala Mac story B-3e9a: `node bin/koala.js check --json`, `node bin/koala.js doctor --format=json`, plain `node bin/koala.js check`, and plain `node bin/koala.js doctor`. B-39d9 owns core readiness; B-3e9a owns running those commands in the Koala Mac wrapper worktree.
items.userSees: Core test output passes, and the handoff says exactly which Koala Mac wrapper commands must show `runtimeMode` and the first-screen JS footprint summary.
